title: Quick Earthy Portuguese Oats Stir Fry
description: A hearty and earthy Portuguese dish featuring ground oats, perfect for a post-workout snack, this stir-fry is FODMAP-friendly and packed with crunchy texture and flavor. It combines the earthiness of oats and mushrooms with the freshness of parsley and lemon.

ingredients.name: ground oats
ingredients.notes: rolled oats blended into a coarse flour

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the ground oats and cook for 2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the oats are lightly browned and fragrant.
Stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
